_comment: Single source of truth for shadcn reference cases. tools/capture_shadcn_local.py renders each id from the local reference app; tools/shadcn-reference-app/src/cases.tsx must declare a matching id (the capture reports FAIL if it does not). Adding a case is one row here plus one entry there -- no tiling, no hand-matched framing.

cases.why: All six shadcn button variants in declaration order.
sm/default/lg -- the heights our hardcoded 40dp fallbacks get compared against.

Two primary-on-muted progress indicators at 25% and 65%.
